title: Clinical Cross-Species Convergence
description: Falsification-side coverage for clinical and cross-species convergence predictions. Tests whether clinical populations show predicted APGI parameter deviations (Cohen's d ≥ 0.5) and whether non-mammalian systems exhibit ignition-like threshold dynamics (allometric exponent deviation ≤ 30%).

sub_predictions.claim: Clinical groups (GAD, MDD, Psychosis) show predicted APGI parameter deviations vs. healthy controls
sub_predictions.key_measurement_equation: Cohen_d >= 0.5 for APGI parameter differences in >=2 of 3 clinical groups
sub_predictions.confirming_evidence: At least 2 of 3 clinical groups show d >= 0.5 deviation from controls in predicted direction.
sub_predictions.falsifying_evidence: Fewer than 2 clinical groups show d >= 0.5 — APGI clinical specificity claim is falsified.

sub_predictions.claim: Non-mammalian systems (invertebrate, cephalopod, avian) exhibit ignition-like threshold dynamics
sub_predictions.key_measurement_equation: allometric_exponent_deviation < 0.30 AND >=2 of 3 non-mammalian systems show bistable attractor dynamics
sub_predictions.confirming_evidence: Allometric scaling matches theory within 30% and >=2 non-mammalian systems show ignition thresholds.
sub_predictions.falsifying_evidence: Non-mammalian systems show only continuous graded processing without thresholds — universality claim is falsified.

validation_notes: FP-13 stub — not yet implemented. Partial validation coverage: VP_12_ClinicalCrossSpeciesConvergence.py. Partial falsification coverage: FP_12_CrossSpeciesScaling.py.

inclusion_criteria: Clinical population data available (GAD, MDD, or Psychosis cohort)
Non-mammalian neurophysiology dataset available or simulated
exclusion_criteria: Insufficient clinical sample sizes (n < 12 per group)
Non-mammalian data with non-comparable recording modalities

apparatus.execution_environment: APGI desktop application and local project runtime

target.type: Clinical EEG/fMRI dataset or simulated non-mammalian neural dynamics

trial_structure.response: Falsification decision for clinical profiles and cross-species scaling checks

blocks.notes: Sub-Protocol A (clinical) and Sub-Protocol B (cross-species) are independent analysis blocks.

dependent_variables: Cohen's d for APGI parameter deviation in clinical groups
Allometric scaling exponent deviation from APGI theory
Proportion of non-mammalian systems with ignition-like dynamics
primary_hypothesis: Clinical populations will show APGI-predicted parameter deviations (d ≥ 0.5), and non-mammalian systems will exhibit ignition-like threshold dynamics consistent with APGI universality claims.
primary_analysis: Statistical comparison of APGI parameters across clinical and control groups; allometric regression of APGI parameters vs. brain mass; threshold detection in non-mammalian simulations.

power_analysis.based_on: Clinical effect size estimate d = 0.5 from VP-12 protocol specification

ethics.exempt_reason: Archival/public clinical data used under prior institutional approval or exemption.

submission_blocking_issues: FP_13 is a stub — ClinicalCrossSpeciesProtocol.run_validation() returns not_implemented.
Clinical dataset integration not yet completed.
caveats: FP-13 is a tertiary-tier extension, not a canonical EP falsification criterion.
FP_12_CrossSpeciesScaling.py provides overlapping but distinct cross-species coverage.
